summary: Rodrigo Duterte ran a death squad that killed over a thousand people as mayor of Davao City, then won the Philippine presidency in 2016 with an online troll army and launched a national drug war that killed thousands.
keywords: Fire and Fury in the Philippines

evidence.note: birth in 1945 just before Philippine independence
made acting vice mayor after 1986, elected mayor of Davao in 1988
founding of the Davao Death Squad in the mid-1990s and its victims
Marcos era, constitutional manoeuvre and martial law get an extended segment
paid social media army and fake news during the 2016 campaign
Facebook free mobile internet app creates a walled news environment
first year of the national drug war, police and vigilante killings
story runs to 2018: capital punishment push and martial law on Mindanao

notes: Spanish and US colonial history (1520s-1902) is background before the story begins, so it is left out of covered_span and themes. Davao Death Squad typed criminal-org, though it was run by off-duty police with city funds; police would also be defensible. dictator-autocrat is third because the host says he is not quite a dictator yet.
